title: Apache Web Server Hardening
story: A vulnerable Apache server contains insecure configurations. Students must secure the web server and reduce attack surface.

tasks.title: Disable Directory Listing
tasks.description: Prevent Apache from exposing directory indexes.

tasks.title: Configure HTTPS
tasks.description: Enable HTTPS for the web server.
tasks.hint: Enable SSL and configure a TLS virtual host.

tasks.title: Remove Insecure Modules
tasks.description: Disable unnecessary or risky Apache modules.
tasks.hint: Use a2dismod for modules that are not required.

tasks.title: Harden Headers
tasks.description: Add security headers that reduce browser-side risk.
tasks.hint: Set headers such as X-Frame-Options and X-Content-Type-Options.

tasks.title: Restart Apache
tasks.description: Restart Apache and confirm the hardened service is running.
